name: Drive build — photoreal self-contained web build

webxr.note: bloom dropped inside XR session (EffectComposer not XR-aware)

gate6_holoGate.entry_portal_menu: world-space panel; pull trigger to ENTER then to graduate
gate6_holoGate.interaction: controller raycast -> PortalIntent{kind:grab} -> validatePortalIntent(intent, HoloDoorPolicy, "drive-avatar") -> graduate gem rises a tier
gate6_holoGate.note: a grab MUTATES only after HoloGate validates it against the spatial scope; read-only/mutate-zone-without-glob are rejected

desktopFirstPerson.controls: click-to-lock pointer; WASD/arrow movement; mouse look; Shift speed; E graduate; F inspect full entry
desktopFirstPerson.camera: player-position + yaw/pitch, no auto-orbit after entry

goldFullData.note: the right-side panel shows the full markdown body, not only metadata; live mode re-reads D:/GOLD through server.cjs

startOnboarding.firstObjective: reach a glowing entry, open its full GOLD record, then graduate it
startOnboarding.nextObjective: follow the record upward after the first graduation

playableHoloGraph.interaction: HoloGraph button / G key opens lineage constellation; selecting a node dispatches gold-entry-selected and opens full GOLD data
